description: Algorithmic decision rules and heuristics for automated Granblue Fantasy party, weapon grid, and supporter summon selection.

fire.rationale: Water deals 1.5x damage and takes 0.75x damage vs Fire. Crits and Seraphic amplification active.

water.rationale: Earth deals 1.5x damage and takes 0.75x damage vs Water. Crits and Seraphic amplification active.

earth.rationale: Wind deals 1.5x damage and takes 0.75x damage vs Earth. Crits and Seraphic amplification active.

wind.rationale: Fire deals 1.5x damage and takes 0.75x damage vs Wind. Crits and Seraphic amplification active.

light.rationale: Dark deals 1.5x superior damage vs Light. Normal damage taken. Crits and Seraphic amplification active.

dark.rationale: Light deals 1.5x superior damage vs Dark. Normal damage taken. Crits and Seraphic amplification active.

plain.rationale: Plain/Null enemies have no elemental weakness. High raw burst setups (e.g. Dark Ereshkigal or Light Nehan/Viking) are preferred.

pbhl.name: Prototype Bahamut HL
pbhl.reasoning: Starts Dark, shifts through Fire/Water/Earth/Wind phases (50-25%), then returns to Dark. Light burst (Viking/Nehan) and Dark burst (Ereshkigal) dominate the 1.48M blue chest race.

akasha.name: Akasha HL
akasha.reasoning: Boss is Dark. Light is natural superior element; Dark burst setups with turn compression also compete effectively.

gohl.name: Grand Order HL
gohl.reasoning: Boss has multi-element forms and Peacemaker buff. Light and Dark racing setups achieve the fastest 1.48M honor burst.

subhl.name: Super Ultimate Bahamut
subhl.reasoning: Requires coordinated 6-player elemental labor fulfillment (Ten Thousand Paths, 20M damage omens, 60-hit omens).

gridSynergyRules.description: Main Character (MC) mainhand weapon element MUST match the intended party element. MC normal attacks and ougi element are dictated by the mainhand weapon.
All frontline characters must share the party element to receive weapon grid skill multipliers (Magna / Primal ATK & HP). Off-element characters receive near-zero grid bonuses.
When fighting on-element, the party MUST include a Seraphic weapon (e.g. Sword of Michael) or an Ultima Weapon with Seraphic Gauph Key for +20% to +25% un-capped damage amplification.

For high-level raids (Magna 3, Six Dragons, Revans, Guild Wars), bosses feature 50%-100% off-element damage resistance. Attempting these raids with an off-element party results in immediate failure or sub-10% honors.
Weapon grid critical hit rate (Verity / Tech) is only effective on superior element. Do not build crit-focused grids for neutral or off-element encounters.
